exposure: Pneumatic uterine bracket pressure (240 mmHg, 260 mmHg, 280 mmHg)
cohort: 148 pregnant women undergoing cesarean section under combined spinal-epidural anesthesia.
finding: The optimal pressure within the pneumatic uterine bracket for preventing supine hypotension syndrome is about 260 mmHg, which also improves intraoperative comfort.
mod_finding: The study found that a pneumatic uterine bracket pressure of 260 mmHg is optimal for preventing SHS and improving comfort during cesarean section.
